secrets.name: NETWORK_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.label: Session signing key
secrets.description: Signs device sessions and their cookies. A new one signs every device out until it signs in again. To rotate without that, set it by hand to new:old.

secrets.name: OPAQUE_USER_ID_SECRET
secrets.label: Account id key
secrets.description: Turns each sign-in into the account id the Durable Objects store everything under. Make one only where it is missing: a new one gives every account a new id, cut off from its devices and workspaces on the server.

secrets.name: RENDEZVOUS_SECRET
secrets.label: Discovery key
secrets.description: Makes the ids friends find each other by and signs lobby certificates. A new one changes every discovery id, and open tabs need a reload.

secrets.name: TURN_KEY_ID
secrets.label: TURN key id
secrets.description: Cloudflare Realtime TURN key, which relays calls and file transfers that cannot connect directly.

secrets.name: TURN_KEY_API_TOKEN
secrets.label: TURN key token
secrets.description: The same TURN key's token, which the Worker gives short-lived TURN credentials with.
